root.desc: LiveArchiveEncoder — re-encode footage at the pace a 1998 archive box would have.

repl.needsTerminal: ERROR: 'repl' needs an interactive terminal; stdin or stdout is redirected.

encode.desc: Re-encode one source at archive pace.

opt.out: Output path. Defaults to the source name with the encoder's extension.
opt.encoder: Video encoder, e.g. mpeg4, libx264, flv. Defaults to the stored one.
opt.container: Container extension, e.g. avi, mkv, mp4. Defaults to the encoder's own.
opt.quality: Quality in the encoder's own scale (2..31 for the mpeg family, 0..51 for x264).
opt.preset: Start from one of your stored presets; 'lae preset list' shows them.
opt.limit: Bitrate ceiling in kbps. The ladder drops frames rather than exceed it.
opt.recover: Bitrate the ladder climbs back from; defaults to 75% of the ceiling.
opt.dryRun: Print the two FFmpeg command lines and stop.
opt.subtitleFile: Burn this .srt/.ass into the picture; repeat for more than one.
opt.subtitleTrack: Burn the embedded subtitle track with this absolute index.
opt.subtitleCopy: Carry this subtitle track into the output as a stream; repeat for more than one.
opt.subtitleBox: Shape the text is laid out in: source, 4:3 or 16:9.
opt.subtitleFont: Font family forced over whatever the subtitle file asks for.
opt.fontsDir: Extra folder libass may look in for fonts.
opt.recompress: One FFmpeg fragment for a post-encode pass; repeat for a chain (a 2007 portal first, then the 2011 one).
opt.recompressContainer: Container for a post-encode pass, paired by position with --recompress.
opt.recompressOnly: Run the chain against the existing file and skip the capture entirely.

plan.qualityBitrate: no quality knob; the ceiling is the only dial
plan.ladderValue: {{rungs}} fps, down at {{down}} kbps, up at {{up}} kbps, over {{window}}s
plan.ladderOff: off (single rung or no bitrate ceiling)

result.motionValue: ended at {{fps}} fps{{rung}}, {{dropped}} decoded frames dropped
result.skippedValue: {{dropped}} decoded frames skipped while the encoder caught up; the ladder never moved
result.frozenTailValue: the source ran out {{slots}} slot(s) early; the tail repeats the last frame

error.runSetup: Run 'lae setup' for what to do about it.
error.noEncoder: ERROR: this FFmpeg build has no encoder named '{{name}}'.
error.encoderSuggestions: Try one of: mpeg4, mpeg1video, flv, libx264.
error.presetMissing: there is no preset named '{{id}}'; run 'lae preset list'
error.subtitleMix: --subtitle-track burns one track and --subtitle-copy carries others; they are different jobs, pick one
error.containerPairing: {{given}} containers were given for {{passes}} passes; there is nothing for the extra one to belong to
error.noFile: ERROR: there is no file at '{{path}}'

config.desc: Show, locate or migrate the settings file.

path.desc: Print the settings file path and exit.

show.desc: Print the effective settings as key = value lines.
show.toml: Print the document as TOML, in the shape the store would write it.

migrate.desc: Convert an older config file (v7 JSON or v8 JSON) into settings.toml.
migrate.dryRun: Report what would change without writing anything.
migrate.noFileStore: ERROR: this build has no settings file to migrate.
migrate.previousAuto: {{path}} is the previous v8 file; it is converted automatically on the next read.
migrate.nothing: No v7 settings found at {{path}}; nothing to migrate.
migrate.notWritten: ERROR: {{path}} was not written; the v7 file is still the only copy.
migrate.notV7: ERROR: {{path}} is not a v7 settings file.

preset.desc: List, inspect, add or remove your own encode presets.

arg.newId: Id for the preset: letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'.

opt.label: Human name to show in a list.
opt.quality: Quality in the encoder's own scale (2..31 for the mpeg family, 0..51 for x264).
opt.keep: Fill every unspecified field from the current defaults instead of leaving it open.

list.empty: no presets; 'lae preset add <id> --encoder mpeg4 --size 320x240' makes one

show.desc: Print one preset, field by field.
show.missing: ERROR: there is no preset named '{{id}}'.
show.seeList: Run 'lae preset list' to see the ones you have.

add.desc: Store a preset, or replace the one with this id.

setup.desc: Check that FFmpeg and ffprobe are available. Exits 1 when they are not.
setup.sourceNotInstalled: The selected source '{{id}}' is not installed here yet.
setup.fix:
To fix it: run 'lae toolchain install' (BtbN snapshot, about 80 MB), then
'lae setup' again. Or put ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH, or point
 toolchain.ffmpegPath at a build you already have.
setup.noDownload:
This command only reports. Nothing is downloaded behind your back: 'lae
toolchain install' is the one that fetches.

toolchain.desc: Install, list and choose the FFmpeg this program uses.

list.desc: Show the builds installed here and which one is in use.
list.hint: Install one with: lae toolchain install <id>   ({{ids}})
list.pathSelected: Source is 'path': whatever ffmpeg this machine offers.

install.desc: Download and unpack an FFmpeg build into this program's own folder.

arg.id: Which build to install: btbn (default) or nonfree.

opt.proxy: HTTP proxy for the download, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:10808.
opt.front: Fetch through a GitHub front, e.g. gh-proxy.com. Remembered for next time.
opt.noFront: Go straight to GitHub, and remember that choice.
opt.from: Install from an archive already on disk instead of downloading one.

install.notSelected: It is installed but not selected; run 'lae toolchain use {{id}}' to encode with it.

remove.wasSelected: '{{id}}' was the selected source. Choose another with 'lae toolchain use <id>', or 'lae toolchain use path'.

use.desc: Choose which installed build an encode uses.

arg.id: Which build to use, or 'path' for the machine's own.

use.notInstalled: '{{id}}' is not installed yet; run 'lae toolchain install {{id}}' first.

path.desc: Print the ffmpeg an encode would run, and exit 1 when there is none.
path.none: ERROR: no ffmpeg found; run 'lae toolchain install' or 'lae setup'

error.unknownSource: '{{id}}' is not a source this build knows; available: {{ids}}
error.wrongPlatform: '{{id}}' is built for {{platform}}, and this machine runs {{current}}
error.notAnArchive: the downloaded data is not a {{kind}} archive
error.htmlInsteadOfArchive: the server answered with a web page instead of the archive; that is a block or an interstitial -- try again, or use --proxy / --front
error.noFfmpegInside: the archive unpacked, but there is no ffmpeg inside it
error.finishedWithoutFfmpeg: unpacking finished but no ffmpeg landed in {{path}}
error.badProxy: '{{value}}' is not a valid proxy address
error.stalled: the download stopped delivering data for {{seconds}}s, after {{mb}} MB
error.noTar: a .tar.xz archive needs tar; install xz-utils (Debian/Ubuntu) or xz (RHEL/AlmaLinux)
error.tarFailed: tar exited with {{code}}: {{detail}} -- is xz-utils installed?
error.tarTimeout: tar took longer than ten minutes and was stopped

history.limitWarn: ERROR: --limit wants a positive number of rows.
history.header: id  started          result     encoder/container  kbps  in → out
history.problem: ERROR: the history database could not be read: {{detail}}

list.desc: Print the most recent runs, newest first.

path.desc: Print where the history is kept.
